events.description: Fireman No. 1 asks whether Fireman No. 2 and Fireman No. 3 told Phoebe Buffay, Rachel Green, and Monica Geller that Fireman No. 2 and Fireman No. 3 were married.
Fireman No. 1 says that Fireman No. 2 and Fireman No. 3 were married.
Fireman No. 3 says that Fireman No. 1 is kidding.
Fireman No. 3 says that Fireman No. 3's girlfriend does not know that Fireman No. 3 is married.
Fireman No. 3 says that Fireman No. 3 is not going to tell Phoebe Buffay, Rachel Green, and Monica Geller that Fireman No. 3 is married.
